## History
- **The First Freeze.** An arcane cataclysm millennia ago locked the region in permanent winter, burying an ancient civilization beneath the ice
- **Nomad Clans Rise.** Survivors adapted to the tundra, forming hardy nomadic clans that follow mammoth migration routes
- **The Binding.** Ancient druids sealed a primordial evil beneath the Glacier of Whispers — the ritual's runes still glow faintly on the ice
- **Modern Tensions.** Southern nations eye the Bleaklands for rumored mineral wealth, sending expeditions that rarely return

## Settlements
- Frosthollow — largest permanent settlement, a trading post built around hot springs
- Whitepeak — mountain refuge of the Skyborn clan, known for mammoth husbandry

## Factions & Powers
- **The Skyborn Clan.** Dominant nomadic tribe, claims descent from the ancient civilization
- **The Icebound Wardens.** Druidic order that maintains the seals keeping the ancient evil contained

## Secrets
- The sealed entity beneath the Glacier of Whispers is stirring — tremors have cracked some binding runes
- The Skyborn Clan's "ancestry" is partially fabricated; they were actually servants of the sealed entity before the Binding
- Southern expedition teams have been disappearing not from the cold, but from Warden patrols eliminating anyone who gets too close to the glacier
